plan.title: VSCode extension YOLO mode - read Claude settings and pass --dangerously-skip-permissions flag
plan.overview: Implement Claude settings detection for YOLO mode by adding a new capability (claude-settings.capability.ts) to read .claude/settings.json files and a computer (claude-settings.computer.ts) to determine if YOLO mode is enabled. The orchestrator (extension.ts) will inject the settings capability into command handlers and conditionally prepend --dangerously-skip-permissions to claude commands at 5 locations.

approach.rationale:
Following the existing capability/computer architecture pattern: - Capability handles file I/O (reading JSON files from disk) - Computer handles pure logic (determining YOLO mode from settings object) - Orchestrator makes policy decisions (when to add the flag)
This approach mirrors the existing file-system.capability.ts pattern and maintains the strict separation of concerns. Settings are read fresh on each command (no caching) to ensure real-time updates when users change their Claude configuration.
Key patterns being followed: - Factory DI pattern at file-system.capability.ts:16-48 - Capability/Computer separation per .kanban/engineering/patterns/capability-computer.md - Safe JSON parsing with try-catch per apps/kanban/src/scripts/get-skill-config.ts:40-62 - Cross-platform paths with os.homedir() + path.join()

task.name: Manual verification of YOLO mode detection
task.action:
Test scenarios:
1. No settings files exist: - Delete .claude/settings.json and ~/.claude/settings.json (if they exist) - Run a kanban action - Verify command is: claude "/kanban-..."
2. Project-level YOLO mode: - Create .claude/settings.json with: {"dangerously-skip-permissions": true} - Run a kanban action - Verify command is: claude --dangerously-skip-permissions "/kanban-..."
3. Global-level YOLO mode: - Remove project settings - Create ~/.claude/settings.json with: {"defaultMode": "bypassPermissions"} - Run a kanban action - Verify command is: claude --dangerously-skip-permissions "/kanban-..."
4. Project takes precedence: - Set project settings: {"dangerously-skip-permissions": false} - Set global settings: {"dangerously-skip-permissions": true} - Run a kanban action - Verify command is: claude "/kanban-..." (project wins, not YOLO)
5. Invalid JSON: - Put invalid JSON in .claude/settings.json - Run a kanban action - Verify command falls back to: claude "/kanban-..."
task.verify: Manual: Verify all 5 test scenarios pass
task.done: All acceptance criteria verified, YOLO mode works correctly

testing.automated: None required for this feature - pure file reading and boolean logic. Unit tests could be added for the computer (isYoloEnabled) but not required for MVP.
testing.manual: - Verify YOLO flag appears when settings enable it - Verify no flag when settings don't enable it - Verify project settings take precedence over global - Verify graceful fallback on missing/invalid settings - Test all 5 command entry points (runAction, runGlobalAction, startDiscovery, createTask, runNextAction)
testing.regression: Verify commands still work correctly when YOLO mode is NOT enabled (existing behavior preserved)
